tagline: A scouting report for every builder: which hackathons to enter, with the hours you have
extends: Hack Docket, the author's hackathon tracker (built Oct 4-8, 2026): hand-curated list, manual strengths. New: live discovery across platforms through Zetaris, reading the builder's GitHub, the agent pipeline, H-MEM learning from results

zetaris.role: Only data layer. Live Lightning REST tables, CACHE TABLE'd: Devpost open + upcoming (GET), Devfolio search (POST with JSON body), FX rates; SchemaStore view scout.hackathons flattens every platform (LATERAL VIEW explode, prize HTML stripped, currency detected); federated join scout.hackathons x scout.fx converts prizes to USD in SQL. Each new builder's GitHub repos and README are registered as new REST tables + views at run time by the Surveyor. Every fixture cites Zetaris query ids.

scout_intent.role: Intake: registry, lexical scoring, Guard (injection, forbidden actions: register/submit/message/bypass bot checks, claimed organiser authority), HMAC-signed ExecutionContract carrying authority (registers=false, submits=false, messages=false); verified before every query, source registration and docket write; refreshed per Markovian step

hmem.role: Wins from the README, reported results and plans with provenance; the record per skill tag changes the odds

world_model.role: Case file: builder, repos, skills, hackathons, fixtures, evidenced_by queries; single-writer queue

markovian.role: Scouting in bounded steps of six hackathons; carryover = the week's plan (hours left, picks)

runtime.role: Nightshift is the primary AI provider (Meterless Runtime 0.90.0 contract)

meterless.tests: npm test (15 Docket Scout feature tests + 30 engine conformance tests)

nvidia.role: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B scouts every candidate hackathon (deep lane); Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B tags README wins, writes the profile summary, binds logins (fast lane); served by Nightshift

sponsor_technology.coding_tool: Claude Code (Cursor became optional on Oct 22)

data.public: Devpost and Devfolio public listings, open.er-api.com FX, GitHub public repos and READMEs, all live via Zetaris
